service.method: SELECT USMT.USER_NAME_LOC ,USMT.USER_ID ,USMT.EMAIL FROM SBALN BALN JOIN SBAGL BAGL ON BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = BALN.COMPANY_CODE AND BAGL.CTRL_CODE = BALN.CTRL_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON BALN.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND NVL(USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND BALN.CTRL_CODE IN ('QnA_MANAGER', 'QnA_MANAGER_D') GROUP BY USMT.USER_NAME_LOC ,USMT.USER_ID ,USMT.EMAIL

SELECT USMT.USER_NAME_LOC ,USMT.USER_ID ,USMT.EMAIL FROM SBALN BALN LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON BALN.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND NVL(USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND BALN.CTRL_CODE = 'QnA_MASTER'

SELECT Q.HOUSE_CODE , Q.QNA_NUMBER , Q.ADD_DATE , Q.ADD_TIME , Q.ADD_USER_ID AS WRITE_USER_ID , QR.QNA_SEQ , QR.ADD_USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.EMAIL FROM SQNAQ Q INNER JOIN SQNAR QR ON Q.HOUSE_CODE = QR.HOUSE_CODE AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = QR.QNA_NUMBER INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON Q.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND Q.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND QR.ADD_USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER}

SELECT Q.QNA_NUMBER ,Q.COMPANY_CODE ,Q.SUBJECT ,Q.ATTACH_NO ,Q.KEYWORDS ,Q.CONTENT ,Q.ADD_USER_ID ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND USER_ID = Q.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME ,Q.ADD_DATE ,Q.ADD_TIME ,Q.QNA_COMPANY ,Q.QNA_TYPE FROM SQNAQ Q WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND NVL(Q.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
SELECT * FROM SFILE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DOC_NO = ${ATTACH_NO} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT Q.QNA_NUMBER, Q.ADD_USER_ID, Q.ADD_DATE, Q.ADD_TIME, USMT.USER_NAME_LOC, USMT.EMAIL FROM SQNAQ Q INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = Q.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = Q.ADD_USER_ID WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND NVL(Q.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT Q.QNA_NUMBER , Q.SUBJECT , Q.ADD_DATE , Q.ADD_TIME , Q.ADD_USER_ID AS WRITER_ID , W.USER_NAME_LOC AS WRITER_NAME , W.EMAIL AS WRITER_EMAIL , Q.MANAGER AS MANAGER_ID , M.USER_NAME_LOC AS MANAGER_NAME , M.EMAIL AS MANAGER_EMAIL FROM SQNAQ Q INNER JOIN SUSMT W ON W.HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND W.COMPANY_CODE = Q.COMPANY_CODE AND W.USER_ID = Q.ADD_USER_ID AND NVL(W.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT M ON M.HOUSE_CODE = Q.HOUSE_CODE AND M.COMPANY_CODE = Q.COMPANY_CODE AND M.USER_ID = Q.MANAGER AND NVL(M.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' WHERE Q.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND Q.QNA_NUMBER = ${QNA_NUMBER} AND NVL(Q.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
